channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike more than 100km into Russian territory
item.description: Ukrainian drones struck the Saratov region. The regional governor reported one person was killed.

item.title: Houthi missiles intercepted over Saudi Arabia as battles intensify
item.description: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted missiles targeting Riyadh and Dhahran, with falling debris injuring people.

item.title: Kyiv hit by Russian ballistic missiles for second day with no warning
item.description: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv for a second consecutive day without advance warning.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi coalition hits Houthi sites; Aramco office hit in east
item.description: A Saudi Aramco building has been hit in Dhahran, following Saudi-led coalition strikes on Houthi 'vital assets' in Yemen

item.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
item.description: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

item.title: Missiles intercepted near Riyadh after Saudi coalition hits Yemen fuel depot
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen struck a fuel depot near the Houthi-controlled capital, Sanaa.
